block.title: Hero alt: both fighters in crossfire, boss eye framing the shot
block.positive: SNES-era 16-bit pixel art inspired concept rendering, bold dark outlines, saturated limited palette, widescreen arcade ensemble composition, subtle CRT scanline glow; homepage banner key art, ultra-detailed large-format art with clean vector shapes and pixel-art texture accents. A two-protagonist ambush seen from the side: left of center, a sleek steel-blue dart fighter with cyan canopy pours orange afterburner upward; right of center and crossing its path, a flat ray-winged manta fighter in pale mint with a green canopy and twin amber thrusters rolls under the first ship's exhaust, the two contrails weaving one lazy over-under knot — cooperative choreography frozen mid-decision. Framing the whole pair from the far edges of the image: the head of a deep-water leviathan boss, cropped so we see only its right half — a mountain of charcoal armor plates top-right with a single molten amber sensor-eye the size of both ships combined, its pupil a violet slit catching their engine light, and from the lower-left its counterpart jaw-ridge rising with barnacle-cluster turrets, so the ships fly inside the outline of something that is entirely around them and has not yet decided to close its mouth. Between the two hull-walls, a curtain of pink and violet bead-bullets falls in two slow waterfalls that the ships have a hand's-width of clean lane between. Background: black-blue abyssal water with drifting biolume specks in teal, rock spire shadows below, faint shafts of impossible light from above. Cool abyss palette punctuated by the four hero colors — blue, cyan, mint, amber — the only warm-blooded things in the picture. Lifted deep-navy base, never pure black. No text, no letters, no UI, keep the very center band calm for overlaid headline copy.
